items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I remember when I was singing at Fred Payne's Artist Club in Paris.

ctx.x: Well, I don't say that I was homesick, but there were times when I would want to go back. Now, for instance, every time I would leave Chicago and come to New York to record, I couldn't get back to Chicago fast enough. I always left on the next train.

Now, when I was in Europe, when I -- now, I remember when I was singing at Fred Payne's Artist Club in Paris. I -- there was a song-- when the -- what is that -- there was -- "some in clover the white cliffs of Dover"--
It's called The White Cliffs of Dover.
